task_name: Verranza Coastal Retreats - Villa collection image system
client_brief:
Three villas, one collection: imagery, crops and the gate monogram

For Verranza Coastal Retreats, the challenge is consistency without making three different villas interchangeable. We need the stone, limewash and coastal light to sit comfortably together across direct bookings and agent materials. The supplied do-not-want references are important.

Please prepare
- Villa booking hero: 3 named exports. The named villa matches the photograph. The offer price agrees with the approved rate record. The booking action is readable.
- Villa comparison brochure: 1 named export. Villa identities are unambiguous. The comparison makes differences between the properties easy to scan. Rates preserve their stated season.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Luxury vacation rental collection of three villas above a cove, letting direct and to a small travel-agent trade channel, hospitality and travel.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Liguria, Italy; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Verranza Coastal Retreats is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Liguria, Italy, and this commission covers phase 1: villa image system and booking imagery.
brand_identity.audience: Guests aged 35 to 60, American and Northern European families and groups of friends booking a whole house for a week, plus a small trade channel of travel agents working from printed rate cards. They pay for a real place and refuse anything that looks staged or cooked.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Upper-mid coastal rental, 520 to 780 euros a night in season. A restraint band, not a gloss band: honest light and true water rather than saturated marketplace glow, and firmly above budget literalism.
brand_identity.typography: Verranza Coastal Retreats runs the booking heroes in four steps. Step 01 is the house name in Canela Deck Light at 72 px on 78 px with tracking of minus 10 units, and its first letter is drawn to twice the cap height of the rest of the word, roughly 144 px, so Casa Oliveto opens on one tall C. Step 02 is the standfirst, also Canela Deck Light, at 26 px on 30 px with tracking of minus 4 units, with Light the heaviest weight the serif may take. Step 03 is body and the booking line in Untitled Sans Regular at 20 px on 30 px, tracking 0, held to a maximum of 65 characters. Step 04 is rates and captions in Untitled Sans Regular at 15 px on 22 px with tracking of plus 8 units and tabular lining figures. In the brochure the name is 34 pt, body 10 pt on 15 pt and rates 9 pt. No numeral is ever set in the serif, and there is no gold.
brand_identity.voice: Warm, plain and place-first. We name the stone, the water and the afternoon light, and we never oversell. Example line: 'Three houses above the cove, let by the family who has kept them.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The collection has never had a logo file. The monogram exists only as the wrought-iron plate the village smith cut when the first house was bought, and all we hold is a photograph of it on the gate. The travel-agent rate cards survive only as the file the printer sent to press last year, with no working source.
brand_identity.values: Honest representation of a real place, true water and true stone, and a family mark used quietly.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: Each house name opens with an oversized Canela Deck Light initial at twice the cap height of the rest of the word, and no numeral is ever set in the serif.

scale.note: House name. The first letter is drawn to twice the cap height of the rest of the word, about 144 px against a 72 px name, so Casa Oliveto opens on one tall C. Brochure equivalent 34 pt.

scale.sample: Three houses above the cove, kept by the family.
scale.note: Standfirst. Light is the heaviest weight the serif is allowed.

scale.sample: Book the whole house for a week, direct with the family.
scale.note: Max 65 characters. Also carries the booking line at this size. Brochure body 10 pt on 15 pt.

scale.sample: 520 to 780 euros a night in season
scale.note: Rates and captions, tabular lining figures. Brochure rates 9 pt. No numeral is ever set in the serif.

type_system.signature_move: Each house name opens with an oversized Canela Deck Light initial drawn to twice the cap height of the rest of the word, and every numeral stays in Untitled Sans tabular lining figures, never in the serif.
rules: No numeral is ever set in the serif. Every figure lives in Untitled Sans, tabular lining.
No weight above Light in Canela Deck.
The oversized initial is always the first letter of the house name, at twice the cap height of the rest of that word.
Rates and captions are Untitled Sans Regular only.
Name the stone, the water and the light, and never oversell.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.

trajectory_scores.evidence: Source-to-output bindings stayed explicit for each villa, and every final check used the latest exported file named in the contract.
The run completed, but a 22-image straighten call returned only 10 outputs and two concurrent auto-tone chunks returned HTTP 504 before connector-safe recovery.
The agent detected the incomplete batch and HTTP 504 responses, retried only missing inputs in smaller chunks, then reviewed all outputs and the three center-fallback hero crops.
All three PNGs were decoded and measured at 1920 x 1080; the brochure was decoded, counted at 6 pages, checked at A4 trim, and all rendered pages were visually inspected.
Tool failures, retries, the center-crop fallback, and the still-pending independent creative review are disclosed in the trajectory and release state.

retries.failure: Adobe rejected the public annotation S3 source domain as untrusted.
retries.recovery: Downloaded the canonical public sources and uploaded them to Adobe Creative Cloud in one 22-file ingestion call.

retries.failure: Legacy fit=contain parameter was rejected by the current crop/resize schema.
A single 22-image request returned only the first 10 outputs.
retries.recovery: Retained those 10 and processed the unreturned 12 in chunks of 10 and 2.

retries.failure: Two concurrent 10-image requests returned Adobe transport HTTP 504.
retries.recovery: Retried the first 20 images sequentially in four chunks of five; the final two-image chunk had already succeeded.

retries.failure: Sandbox DNS blocked direct resolution of photoshop-api.adobe.io.
retries.recovery: Used the approved escalated curl network path and parallel downloads.

retries.failure: Initial sequential download was too slow for 22 full-resolution PNGs.
retries.recovery: Canceled the sequential transfer and restarted with curl parallelism capped at eight.

trajectory_steps.title: Contract and output register loaded
trajectory_steps.decision: Use the Gatsby V5 task record as the delivery contract.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The output list, dimensions, page counts, brand constraints, and source bindings were read before editing.

trajectory_steps.title: Canonical source inventory
trajectory_steps.decision: Bind exactly 12 approved photoreal inputs.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Every listed source matched the authoritative manifest SHA-256 and byte count.

trajectory_steps.title: Owner-note reconciliation
trajectory_steps.decision: Use Scogliera sleeps 10 from the owner note, overriding the CSV value 9.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The explicit owner note is the more authoritative task input for occupancy.

trajectory_steps.title: Collection scope normalized
trajectory_steps.decision: Exclude Casa Fienile and translate S1/S2/S3 into Spring, High Summer, and Autumn.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Only Oliveto, Scogliera, and Verranza belong to this collection.

trajectory_steps.title: Creative constraints fixed
trajectory_steps.decision: Preserve true water, stone, limewash, and available light; avoid glow and crushed blacks.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: A restrained coastal treatment keeps the places distinct without overselling them.

trajectory_steps.title: Representative preview selected
trajectory_steps.decision: Use oliveto_bedroom.jpg for the approval preview.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: It exposes the task's dominant correction problem while remaining representative of the full set.

trajectory_steps.title: Source state diagnosed
trajectory_steps.decision: Dim interior and green cast; preserve timber, terracotta, and window detail.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The diagnosis was made from the actual uploaded pixels before targeted adjustments.

trajectory_steps.title: Adobe workflow initialized
trajectory_steps.decision: Use Adobe connectors for every photographic transformation.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Local code is limited to evidence indexing, layout assembly, export, hashing, and verification.

trajectory_steps.title: Runtime preset catalog inspected
trajectory_steps.decision: Select OpenAI Airy Horizon from the returned Adobe preset catalog.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The preset name was discovered at runtime and validated in the approved representative preview.

trajectory_steps.title: Sources ingested into Adobe
trajectory_steps.decision: Upload all 22 canonical photographs in one connector call, then retain the returned Adobe asset IDs.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The public S3 host was rejected by Adobe, so verified local copies were uploaded through the connector.

trajectory_steps.title: Preview downscale
trajectory_steps.decision: Downscale proportionally for rapid review without changing aspect ratio.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The connector output was captured immediately and retained as its own trajectory state.

trajectory_steps.title: Preview auto-straighten
trajectory_steps.decision: Apply automatic leveling with constrained crop.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The connector output was captured immediately and retained as its own trajectory state.

trajectory_steps.title: Preview auto-tone

trajectory_steps.reasoning: The connector output was captured immediately and retained as its own trajectory state.

trajectory_steps.title: Preview task-specific look
trajectory_steps.decision: Apply the proposed task-specific color and luminance correction.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The connector output was captured immediately and retained as its own trajectory state.

trajectory_steps.title: Preview Adobe preset
trajectory_steps.decision: Apply the catalog preset OpenAI Airy Horizon.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The connector output was captured immediately and retained as its own trajectory state.

trajectory_steps.reasoning: The connector output was captured immediately and retained as its own trajectory state.

trajectory_steps.title: Preview visually verified
trajectory_steps.decision: Accept the proposed grade for full-batch application.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The after state improves tonal balance while retaining subject identity, texture, and detail.

trajectory_steps.title: Explicit user approval captured
trajectory_steps.decision: Proceed with both full batches after the user replied: ‘Yeah go ahead’.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Adobe's preview gate requires explicit approval before full-batch processing.

trajectory_steps.title: Full batch input state
trajectory_steps.decision: Process all 12 task photographs.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The complete task inventory—not only the representative preview—entered the production run.

trajectory_steps.title: Initial batch truncation observed
trajectory_steps.decision: Do not treat 10 returned results as completion of the 22-image request.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The first request returned only the first ten outputs; the missing twelve were identified by source order.

trajectory_steps.title: Straighten retry chunking
trajectory_steps.decision: Process the unreturned files in connector-safe chunks of 10 and 2.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: This recovered all missing states without repeating the ten successful outputs.

trajectory_steps.title: Full batch straightened
trajectory_steps.decision: All 12 task files have a captured straightened state.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Each individual output is linked beneath this derived contact sheet.

trajectory_steps.title: Local download DNS block
trajectory_steps.decision: Record the sandbox DNS failure rather than omitting the preservation step.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Direct resolution of photoshop-api.adobe.io was blocked inside the sandbox.

trajectory_steps.title: Parallel preservation recovery
trajectory_steps.decision: Use the approved network path with parallelism capped at eight.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The sequential transfer was canceled because full-resolution PNGs were too slow; every completed stage file was then preserved locally.

trajectory_steps.title: Concurrent auto-tone timeout
trajectory_steps.decision: Treat both Adobe HTTP 504 responses as failed chunks and retry only those inputs.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The independent final two-image chunk succeeded and was retained.

trajectory_steps.title: Auto-tone recovery chunking
trajectory_steps.decision: Retry the first twenty inputs sequentially in four chunks of five.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: All four recovery chunks returned five successful outputs.

trajectory_steps.title: Full batch auto-tone complete
